title: Stop Guessing. Let the Algorithm Find the Sweet Spot.: Runtime Invariants and Algorithmic Bounds in Ruby
topic: Stop Guessing. Let the Algorithm Find the Sweet Spot.
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: This paper presents a Ruby implementation of a monotonic search algorithm that locates the minimal integer satisfying a user-supplied predicate without resorting to exhaustive enumeration. The algorithm combines exponential expansion to find an upper bound with a binary refinement phase, guaranteeing $O(\log n)$ predicate evaluations for any monotonic predicate. We formally prove that the search invariant $l \leq a \leq h$ is preserved throughout execution, where $l$ and $h$ are the current lower and upper bounds and $a$ is the true answer. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 9V45 platform shows a mean latency of 72 844.28 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 13 728 ops/s over 30 benchmark runs. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/ruby-algorithms-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261025_130128_stop_guessing__let_the_algorit}.
